title: Adam
summary: The first man, created by God on the sixth day.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 4004 B.C. (Creation of Adam)

birth.note: Year cell "683 1. Adaˉ 920". To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 920 at the end of the name is the lifespan he prints. His table also prints the death at World 930. 1 + 920 is not 930. Both figures are left as printed.

birth.date: Hebrew table, “Adam”: began his life in the year of the world 1
birth.citation: Shuckford, The Sacred and Profane History of the World Connected, 5th ed., revised by James Creighton (London: William Baynes, 1819), vol. 1, Book I, p. 44 (facsimile PDF p. 134)
birth.note: Hebrew table on p. 44, the row headed “Adam”. The same row prints: had his son in year 130 of his life; lived 800 years after that birth; lived in all 930 years. Shuckford introduces the table as the computations of Moses according to our Hebrew Bibles.

birth.citation: Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology and Geography, History and Prophecy, 2nd ed., corrected and improved (London: C. J. G. & F. Rivington, 1830), vol. II, Synopsis of the Chronology, p. xxxii
birth.note: The parenthesis is the Hebrew age. The other age is the one he adopts. The last figure is his B.C. column.
